question: Qual a evolução anual da taxa de mortalidade por estado (MA e RS)?
gold_sql: SELECT mu.estado, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mu.estado, ano ORDER BY mu.estado, ano;
generated_sql: SELECT sub."estado", sub."ano", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sub."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS "taxa_mortalidade" FROM ( SELECT mu."estado", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS "ano", i."MORTE" FROM "internacoes" i JOIN "municipios" mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') ) sub GROUP BY sub."estado", sub."ano" ORDER BY sub."estado", sub."ano";

question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?
gold_sql: SELECT t.trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total_respiratorio, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_anual FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d JOIN tempo t ON i."DT_INTER" = t.data WHERE i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' AND mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY t.trimestre ORDER BY t.trimestre;
generated_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM "DT_INTER") AS trimestre, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS proporcao FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DIAG_PRINC" LIKE 'J%' GROUP BY trimestre ORDER BY trimestre;

question: Compare o IDHM médio dos municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade hospitalar acima e abaixo da média estadual (mínimo de 500 internações).
gold_sql: WITH media_rs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS'), mortalidade_mun AS (SELECT mu.codigo_6d, mu.nome, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mort FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY mu.codigo_6d, mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT CASE WHEN mm.taxa_mort > mr.taxa_media THEN 'Acima da media' ELSE 'Abaixo da media' END AS grupo, COUNT(*) AS qtd_municipios, ROUND(AVG(s.valor), 4) AS idhm_medio FROM mortalidade_mun mm, media_rs mr JOIN socioeconomico s ON mm.codigo_6d = s.codigo_6d AND s.metrica = 'idhm' GROUP BY CASE WHEN mm.taxa_mort > mr.taxa_media THEN 'Acima da media' ELSE 'Abaixo da media' END ORDER BY idhm_medio;
generated_sql: WITH media_estado AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" = 'RS' ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu."nome", COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" = 'RS' GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ) SELECT pm."nome", pm.total, ROUND(pm.taxa, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM por_municipio pm WHERE pm.taxa > (SELECT AVG(taxa) FROM por_municipio) OR pm.taxa < (SELECT AVG(taxa) FROM por_municipio) ORDER BY pm.taxa DESC;

question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?
gold_sql: WITH media_nacional AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_uti_local, ROUND(mn.taxa_uti_nacional, 2) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_nacional mn GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mn.taxa_uti_nacional HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 2 * mn.taxa_uti_nacional ORDER BY taxa_uti_local DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH media_nacional AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti FROM internacoes ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu.nome AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) SELECT pm.municipio, pm.total_internacoes, ROUND(pm.taxa_uti, 2) AS taxa_uti FROM por_municipio pm, media_nacional mn WHERE pm.taxa_uti > 2 * mn.taxa_uti ORDER BY pm.taxa_uti DESC;
